Title: Rajesh's Day

Cast

1. Rajesh - 36 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Hema - 57 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Karan - 60 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Sunita - 25 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Manoj - 34 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd
2. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The bazaar - Day

[Rajesh stands in the bazaar. Hema stands near him.]

Rajesh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rajesh chases the thief through the crowd.]

Rajesh: "Mom, look at this."

[Rajesh shouts for help.]

Rajesh (softly): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The ghat - Day

[Rajesh stands on the ghat. Hema, Karan and Sunita stand near him.]

Karan: "So, here we are!"

[Rajesh drowns in the river.]

Sunita: "No… this cannot be!"
